title: Projects replace Folders
summary: Projects replace Folders, Cosmos workflows run on projects, subtitles look the same everywhere and one-step skill installs.

sections.title: Projects replace Folders
sections.note: Every folder is now a project, with the same files and processes.

items.body: A full workspace: list, board, Gantt, calendar and more
Tasks with dates, checklists, mentions and watchers
A **My work** inbox gathers what is yours

sections.title: Projects run Cosmos workflows
sections.note: Attach a workflow to a project and run it on a folder of files.

items.body: One task and one run per file, with the cost shown first
Deliverables are filed in the project automatically
Translate Video: subtitles look the same in every view and export
Install Vitra skills in one step
Each export burns in the language you exported
Re-runs no longer charge for copies of their inputs
Toggling a switch no longer slides the app up
